newsitem.title: USA: American Bingo sees Q2 EPS $0.08 to $0.10.
newsitem.headline: American Bingo sees Q2 EPS $0.08 to $0.10.

text.p: American Bingo & Gaming Corp said Monday it expects to report earnings per share of $0.08-$0.10 for the second quarter ended June 30, compared to $0.05 per share for the same period a year ago.
The company said it is seeing increased profitability in all of its areas of operation, and it expects its financial performance to "significantly accelerate" in the second half of 1997.
It also said its second quarter results do not yet reflect the expected benefits of a rapid expansion in South Carolina.
The company said it expects to release final second quarter results by the end of July.
Based on preliminary results, the company said revenues for the second quarter exceeded $1.3 million, an increase of over 50 percent from the second quarter of 1996.
Earnings for the second quarter are projected to be $350,000 to $425,000, an increase of about 100 percent from the second quarter of 1996.
American Bingo derives revenues from its 18 bingo centers in Texas, Alabama and South Carolina, and also generates gaming revenues from its 15 video gaming centers in South Carolina.
